spine.act: The illusion of cheerfulness & learned helplessness
spine.claim: Optimism is not positive thinking or denial; it is an active cognitive defense against learned helplessness.

spine.act: The three dimensions of explanatory style
spine.claim: How we explain failure—through permanence, pervasiveness, and personalization—governs whether setbacks paralyze us.

spine.act: Real-world tests: MetLife, politics, and sports
spine.claim: Explanatory style reliably predicts sales success, athletic bounce-back under pressure, and presidential elections.

spine.act: The biological toll & the ABCDE cognitive method
spine.claim: Pessimism degrades physical health and immune response, but the ABCDE disputation method systematically rewires cognitive habits.

spine.act: Flexible optimism & breaking free from the cage
spine.claim: Learned optimism provides flexible cognitive hygiene: deploy optimism for resilience, and realism when risk cannot be compromised.
